verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents automatic syncing of payroll journal entries to QuickBooks, Xero, or any other accounting software. The only nearby items fall short. The app-integrations page says Gusto works with accounting apps, but that describes a partner program, not a journal-entry sync feature. Webhooks such as payroll.paid and "generate payroll reports" are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not the capability itself.
